idea-plugin.name: Solstice Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Solstice Theme is a three-variant dark IntelliJ theme set built around warm celestial palettes and a small layer of ambient motion.

Included themes:

  • Solstice Moon
  • Solstice Sun
  • Solstice Star

Color previews:

Solstice Sun - warm amber tabs, dark espresso editor surfaces, and copper-orange syntax accents.

Solstice Star - deep violet panels, lavender keywords, gold highlights, and a softer cosmic contrast.

Solstice Moon - cool blue sidebars, crisp cyan syntax, rose keywords, and a clean midnight editor tone.

Solstice also includes optional visual extras that make the IDE feel more alive:

  • an animated status bar scene with sun, moon, stars, and water movement
  • badge-style gutter markers and tinted editor rows for explicit Solstice.TODO, Solstice.BUG, Solstice.IDEA, and Solstice.REVIEW comments
  • a JetBrains-style marker board that collects tagged lines across the project and jumps back to them
  • editor popup actions for quickly marking selected code as Solstice.TODO, Solstice.BUG, Solstice.IDEA, and more

Pro feature previews:

Solstice Marker Board - compact marker counts, priority cards, a cinematic harbor overview, gutter markers, and selected marker details in one tool window.

Solstice marker actions - right-click selected code to quickly tag it as Solstice.BUG, Solstice.TODO, Solstice.IDEA, or Solstice.REVIEW.

The result is a theme pack that can stay minimal when you just want the color palette, while still offering a more expressive workflow for people who like lightweight visual feedback inside the editor.
